topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I stare out the window, watching raindrops trace lazy paths down the glass. My flight is delayed, the airport hums with the low murmur of travelers, but to me, it feels like the world has paused. I keep checking my watch, the hands seem to move slower with each passing minute. The event I was supposed to attend, the one I’ve been looking forward to for months, is happening right now. I picture the empty seat that was meant for me, the conversations I hoped to join, the connections I planned to make. My phone rests in my hand, too heavy to lift, a silent reminder of the calls I should be making to let everyone know I won’t be there.
